notablePrerequisites: Efreet Flamepainter does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Efreet Flamepainter.
Efreet Flamepainter triggers, causing you to cast Alrund's Epiphany from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Alrund's Epiphany, causing you to create two 1/1 Bird creature tokens, take an extra turn after this one and exile Alrund's Epiphany.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Alrund's Epiphany from exile into your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.
